exploration.title: Stacked PR Adoption
openQuestions: Adopt GitHub native stacks (public preview) for dependent lanes now, by hand with gh stack link, before Yeet learns stacks — or keep the E7 deferral until GA?
Heavy policy for stack layers: every layer runs the full matrix (today's behaviour), or only the top layer runs Heavy and Yeet merges stacks only from the top?
Main-red admission hold: while main's required checks are red, should Heavy admission return hold for every PR except a declared unblocker (separate from stacking, larger lever on 2026-10-05)?
Yeet stack-aware publish: is a publish --stack-on <pr> flag plus a trunk/parent split of --base the right first slice, and which goal owns it?
Does Yeet's no-rebase law survive GitHub's server-side rebase of child layers after a partial stack merge?
